Part 1 高频 事件 EVENTS

Reading

阅读

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like reading?

Kind of, I'd say. I didn't read much as a kid, apart from suspense novels, which I was really into. These days I read even less, mainly because studying takes up most of my time and energy.

一般般，小时候除了悬疑小说读得不多，现在更少，学习占了大半时间。

Q2Do you prefer to read on paper or on a screen?

I'd say paper, without a doubt. Real books feel better in my hands, and I focus more when there's no screen flashing at me. Plus, flipping actual pages somehow makes reading feel more relaxing.

更喜欢纸质书，拿在手里有感觉，没有屏幕干扰，翻页也更放松。

Q3When do you need to read carefully, and when not?

I read carefully when it's something important, like study materials or textbooks, since every detail matters there. But when it comes to external news or casual posts, I just skim through the headlines and move on.

学习材料、课本会细读，因为细节重要；外界新闻和帖子就只看标题。

Q4Do you prefer scanning or detailed reading?

It really depends on the situation, I'd say. For study material, I prefer detailed reading, because I need to understand every concept properly. For news and general information, though, scanning is more than enough for me.

看情况，学习材料要精读，新闻和一般信息扫读就够了。
